description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling CRUD operations on notes, including Swagger API documentation annotations. It interfaces with a notesController to perform business logic.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all notes, with optional search query.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a note by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by ID.
